items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: And Jim, he would, he always worked days, you know, he'd come home in the evening, he'd go right inside and pick up the fiddle and sit at the piano, you know, and my other brothers, they'd play, and of course I'd play the clarinet.

ctx.x: Jim, yeah. He said he was a real fine cornet player and he took sick, mentally ill, and he was confined. And then he came out and when he came out, my brother said he played fine trombone.
